cases.name: read
cases.request: Read source.txt with read_file, then return its exact contents as the final string.

cases.name: case_sensitive_write
cases.request: Use write_file to create Report.txt containing exactly ready (no newline). Preserve report.txt. Then return final string done.

cases.name: read_then_edit
cases.request: Read config.txt with read_file. Then use replace_text on config.txt to replace the exact text slow with fast. Preserve everything else. Return final string done.

cases.name: grounded_copy
cases.request: Read code.txt with read_file. Use write_file to create copy.txt containing exactly the contents you read. Preserve code.txt. Return final string done.
